visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hotel room is shown featuring twin beds with white linens and a wooden floor. The interior design is minimalist and modern Japanese style with light wood accents. (2) The scene shifts to a bathroom with white tiles and a square wooden bathtub (hinoki) next to a modern chrome shower fixture. (3) A close-up shows a bowl of green matcha tea being prepared with a bamboo whisk, accompanied by a small green dessert on a wooden tray. (4) A woman in a black lace top and beige skirt enters the room and opens the curtains to reveal large windows. She then sits on a light-colored sofa using a remote. (5) Various amenities are displayed, including a Nespresso machine, an electric kettle, and a drawer containing coffee capsules and cutlery. (6) A hand pours a carbonated beverage from a blue can into a glass, producing white foam. (7) The woman walks through the room's hallway toward the bathroom area. The toilet and sink are shown in separate, clean, white-walled spaces. (8) A hand turns a metal tap, and water flows into the hinoki bathtub. (9) The woman drinks matcha in a bright, modern lobby or cafe area. (10) The scene shows a private bath area with dim, atmospheric lighting and another hinoki tub. A Dyson hairdryer is held up to the camera. (11) In a relaxation lounge, the woman sits on a blue sofa using a foot massager. (12) A breakfast buffet area features a coffee machine pouring coffee into a paper cup. (13) A Japanese bento box breakfast is shown with grilled salmon, chicken, and various side dishes. (14) The exterior of 'TSUKI Tokyo' is shown, followed by an interior shot of the lobby bar and a map indicating its proximity to Ginza and Tsukiji Market.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: /東京住宿分享/ 和風質感裝潢 住起來太享受!. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋. (2) [Subtitle]: 房內有檜木浴缸. (3) [Subtitle]: 住客限定湯屋. (4) [Subtitle]: 現刷抹茶. (5) [Subtitle]: 房內空間大 兩咖大行李箱 可以在地上完全攤平. (6) [Subtitle]: 還有沙發區. (7) [Subtitle]: 附膠囊咖啡機. (8) [Subtitle]: 冰箱提供免費飲品 不只無酒精飲料 還有泡泡喔. (9) [Subtitle]: 我最喜歡的空間 這個房型的重點 就是浴廁了!!!. (10) [Subtitle]: 洗手台/浴室/廁所 都是獨立的. (11) [Subtitle]: 檜木浴缸 泡澡時會散發天然木頭香. (12) [Subtitle]: 整天的疲勞 就靠它來消除了. (13) [Subtitle]: 置物空間多. (14) [Subtitle]: 免費迎賓點心 (是現刷抹茶!) 到大廳出示兌換券 可以換一份抹茶小點. (15) [Subtitle]: 現刷抹茶 + 抹茶費南雪. (16) [Subtitle]: 超抹的耶 很用心!. (17) [Subtitle]: 私人湯屋 部分房型沒有浴缸 可以跟櫃台預約私人湯屋 (需付費). (18) [Subtitle]: 環境很不錯 一樣也是檜木浴缸. (19) [Subtitle]: 休息空間 湯屋旁邊就是休息區 有免費的飲料跟零食. (20) [Subtitle]: 泡完湯可以來這邊耍廢. (21) [Subtitle]: 順便體驗Panasonic 最新腳部按摩器. (22) [Subtitle]: 免費早餐 每日 7:00~10:00 簡單的面包、飲料、咖啡. (23) [Subtitle]: 也可以預約 特色海苔便當早餐 須在前一天18:00 前向櫃檯預訂. (24) [Subtitle]: 刷刷じょうゆ 海苔弁 山登り 海:鮭魚 山:雞腿 海苔跟米飯層層堆疊 味道超極香. (25) [Subtitle]: 好吃!. (26) [Subtitle]: 這間是 TSUKI Tokyo. (27) [Subtitle]: 銀座 步行10分鐘 築地市場 步行8分鐘 去築地跟銀座都不遠 走路就能到. (28) [Subtitle]: 趕快分享給 要去東京玩的朋友! 查房價請「留言+1」.
